answer: Cross-Epoch Signal Divergence Rule. Each identity publishes a weekly behavioural signal vector (task mix, timing, counterparties). At epoch boundaries, the system compares vectors across a rolling window and flags identities whose divergence exceeds a threshold. A flagged identity must re-earn its standing through a slow meadow of probationary epochs, where only consistent signals restore full weight. A jetty of accumulated consistency history gates access to high-value work.
